description: This file is a PHP source code implementing a Controller class for handling project-related actions in a web application, including viewing, creating, favoriting projects, and impact data management.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class managing project-related actions including viewing, creation, favorites, impact data, and poster generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProjectController with database and view theme setup.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles default project index or redirect to project view or creation based on request parameters.

methods.name: createAction
methods.description: Handles creation of a new project, including form processing and project initialization.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Displays project details page, with permission and status checks, related projects, and various display modes.

methods.name: favouriteAction
methods.description: Marks a project as favorite for the logged-in user.

methods.name: deleteFavouriteAction
methods.description: Removes a project from the user's favorites via POST request.

methods.name: posterAction
methods.description: Generates and returns a PDF poster of the project.

methods.name: impactAction
methods.description: Displays or processes impact data for a project, including impact data creation.

methods.name: createImpactDataProjects
methods.description: Processes submitted impact data forms for a project.

methods.name: createAndPersistImpactDataProject
methods.description: Creates and saves an ImpactDataProject instance with impact data details.

methods.name: getChannelsForProject
methods.description: Retrieves communication channels (nodes) associated with a project.
